description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractAuditableWithUTCDateTimeCustom' for auditable entities within the Fineract project. It customizes the standard auditing behavior by overriding default column names and using OffsetDateTime for timestamp fields, ensuring UTC storage and proper timezone conversions.

classes.name: AbstractAuditableWithUTCDateTimeCustom
classes.description: An abstract base class for entities that require auditing information, with custom column mappings and OffsetDateTime handling for timestamps, ensuring consistency with UTC and tenant timezone conversions.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the creator as an Optional Long.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp as an Optional OffsetDateTime.

methods.name: getLastModifiedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the last modifier as an Optional Long.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the last modification timestamp as an Optional OffsetDateTime.
